# lakekeeper_generic_table (Data Source)

Read an existing generic (non-Iceberg) table by its project, warehouse UUID and dotted namespace path. Verifies the warehouse belongs to the project. No resources or permissions are changed.

**Upstream API**: [Lakekeeper REST API docs](https://docs.lakekeeper.io/docs/nightly/api/generic-table/#tag/generic-table/operation/load_generic_table)

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lakekeeper_generic_table" "embeddings" {
  project_id   = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
  warehouse_id = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
  namespace    = "ml.images"
  name         = "embeddings"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the generic table.
- `namespace` (String) Dotted namespace path, including all parent levels.
- `project_id` (String) Project UUID.
- `warehouse_id` (String) Warehouse UUID; names are not used to select warehouses.

### Read-Only

- `base_location` (String) Base location of the table.
- `doc` (String) Free-form description, if set.
- `format` (String) Table format, for example `lance`, `delta` or `dataset`.
- `generic_table_id` (String) Generic table UUID used by the protection and permission APIs.
- `id` (String) Composite `project_id/warehouse_id/namespace/name` identity.
- `properties` (Map of String) String properties stored with the table.
- `protected` (Boolean) Whether the table is protected from being dropped.
- `schema` (String) Table schema as a JSON document.
